properties.claim: Another proof that Russia is using the ZNPP (Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant) for military purposes, which is prohibited by international law (Geneva Conventions). , , Here they are testing a "Kurier" multi-purpose assault robots from the same building that houses Reactor 3 of the ZNPP., , The law imposes obligations on all parties to armed conflict to refrain from attacking nuclear power plants and to avoid, as much as possible, any action that would expose them to attack, including locating military objectives at or in the vicinity of such facilities., , More information: https://blogs.icrc.org/law-and-policy/2022/10/18/protection-nuclear-power-plants-armed-conflict/
